quote: capacity (T-AOC, A015-2-1), malondialdehyde (MDA, A003-1-2), superoxide dismutase (SOD, A001-3-2), and catalase (CAT, A007-1-1) in the livers of mandarin fish were determined using commercial kits from the Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute (Nanjing, China) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
statement: 使用南京建成生物工程研究所的试剂盒测定鳜鱼肝脏中的总抗氧化能力、丙二醛、超氧化物歧化酶和过氧化氢酶。
text_zh: 使用南京建成生物工程研究所的试剂盒测定鳜鱼肝脏中的总抗氧化能力、丙二醛、超氧化物歧化酶和过氧化氢酶。
text_en: Total antioxidant capacity, malondialdehyde, superoxide dismutase, and catalase in the liver of mandarin fish were measured using kits from Nanjing Jiancheng Bioengineering Institute.

quote: Juvenile mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ) that were well-domesticated (could successfully consume artificial diets) were reared on the control diet for two weeks prior to the formal trial to acclimate to the experimental conditions.
statement: 实验前对鳜鱼进行两周的驯化以适应实验条件，这些鱼已被成功驯化以摄食人工饲料。
text_zh: 实验前对鳜鱼进行两周的驯化以适应实验条件，这些鱼已被成功驯化以摄食人工饲料。
text_en: Before the experiment, mandarin fish were acclimated for two weeks to adapt to the experimental conditions; these fish had been successfully acclimated to consume artificial feed.

quote: All experimental fish were then fasted for 24 h, and 300 healthy mandarin fish (initial weight 23.73 ± 0.05 g) were randomly divided into four groups, with three tanks in triplicate and 25 fish in each tank.
statement: 实验鱼在分组前禁食24小时，并随机分配到四个组中，每组三个重复缸，每缸25条鱼。
text_zh: 实验鱼在分组前禁食24小时，并随机分配到四个组中，每组三个重复缸，每缸25条鱼。
text_en: The experimental fish were fasted for 24 hours before grouping and randomly assigned to four groups, with three replicate tanks per group and 25 fish per tank.

quote: The experimental fish were then fed with the four groups of diets to apparent satiation twice a day (at 08:30 and 16:00) for 8 weeks.
statement: 实验鱼每天两次（08:30和16:00）投喂至表观饱食状态，持续8周。
text_zh: 实验鱼每天两次（08:30和16:00）投喂至表观饱食状态，持续8周。
text_en: The experimental fish were fed to apparent satiation twice daily (at 08:30 and 16:00) for 8 weeks.

quote: Currently, the implementation of feed additives with antioxidant properties is deemed an effective strategy to alleviate HC-diet-induced oxidative stress in fish.
statement: 目前，实施具有抗氧化特性的饲料添加剂被认为是一种缓解鱼类高碳水化合物日粮诱导的氧化应激的有效策略。
text_zh: 目前，实施具有抗氧化特性的饲料添加剂被认为是一种缓解鱼类高碳水化合物日粮诱导的氧化应激的有效策略。
text_en: Currently, implementing feed additives with antioxidant properties is considered an effective strategy to alleviate oxidative stress induced by high-carbohydrate diets in fish.

quote: For example, studies have shown that dietary taurine and mulberry leaf flavonoids can improve growth performance and alleviate HC-diet-induced oxidative stress and ER stress in hybrid grouper (♀ Epinephelus fuscoguttatus × ♂ E. lanceolatus ), turbot ( Scophthalmus maximus L.), and eel ( Monopterus albus ) [ 17 , 18 , 19 ].
statement: 例如，研究表明，日粮中的牛磺酸和桑叶黄酮可以改善杂交石斑鱼、大菱鲆和鳗鱼的生长性能，并缓解高碳水化合物日粮诱导的氧化应激和内质网应激。
text_zh: 例如，研究表明，日粮中的牛磺酸和桑叶黄酮可以改善杂交石斑鱼、大菱鲆和鳗鱼的生长性能，并缓解高碳水化合物日粮诱导的氧化应激和内质网应激。
text_en: For example, studies have shown that dietary taurine and mulberry leaf flavonoids can improve the growth performance of hybrid grouper, turbot, and eel, and alleviate oxidative stress and endoplasmic reticulum stress induced by high-carbohydrate diets.

population.species: 杂交石斑鱼; 大菱鲆; 鳗鱼

intervention: Dietary taurine and mulberry leaf flavonoids
intervention_record: 日粮添加牛磺酸和桑叶黄酮
outcome: 生长性能、氧化应激与内质网应激

quote: In fish, betaine has traditionally been used as a feed attractant to promote feed intake by stimulating the olfactory bulb
statement: 在鱼类中，甜菜碱传统上用作饲料诱食剂，通过刺激嗅球来促进摄食。
text_zh: 在鱼类中，甜菜碱传统上用作饲料诱食剂，通过刺激嗅球来促进摄食。
text_en: In fish, betaine has traditionally been used as a feed attractant to promote feeding by stimulating the olfactory bulb.

quote: recent evidence suggests that betaine may also improve antioxidant capacity by regulating the activities of antioxidant enzymes such as superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT)
statement: 近期证据表明，甜菜碱可能通过调节超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）等抗氧化酶的活性来提高抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 近期证据表明，甜菜碱可能通过调节超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）等抗氧化酶的活性来提高抗氧化能力。
text_en: Recent evidence suggests that betaine may improve antioxidant capacity by regulating the activity of antioxidant enzymes such as superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT).

quote: Additionally, betaine has been found to reduce endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis
statement: 此外，已发现甜菜碱能减少内质网应激和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 此外，已发现甜菜碱能减少内质网应激和细胞凋亡。
text_en: In addition, betaine has been found to reduce endoplasmic reticulum stress and apoptosis.
outcome: 内质网应激与细胞凋亡

quote: Nevertheless, it is unclear whether dietary betaine supplementation could alleviate the oxidative stress, ER stress, and apoptosis induced by a high carbohydrate diet in fish.
statement: 然而，目前尚不清楚日粮中添加甜菜碱是否能缓解高碳水化合物饮食诱导的鱼类氧化应激、内质网应激和细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 然而，目前尚不清楚日粮中添加甜菜碱是否能缓解高碳水化合物饮食诱导的鱼类氧化应激、内质网应激和细胞凋亡。
text_en: However, it is currently unclear whether dietary betaine supplementation can alleviate fish oxidative stress, endoplasmic reticulum stress, and apoptosis induced by a high-carbohydrate diet.
outcome: 氧化应激、内质网应激与细胞凋亡

quote: To date, mandarin fish have been reported to be able to consume artificially formulated diets well after domestication
statement: 迄今为止，据报道鳜鱼在驯化后能够很好地食用人工配合饲料。
text_zh: 迄今为止，据报道鳜鱼在驯化后能够很好地食用人工配合饲料。
text_en: To date, it has been reported that mandarin fish can feed well on artificial formulated feeds after domestication.

quote: The results showed that the apoptosis signals and the apoptosis rate were significantly higher in the HC group than in the NC group.
statement: 高碳水化合物饮食组的鳜鱼肝脏凋亡信号和凋亡率显著高于正常对照组。
text_zh: 高碳水化合物饮食组的鳜鱼肝脏凋亡信号和凋亡率显著高于正常对照组。
text_en: The liver apoptosis signaling and apoptosis rate in mandarin fish fed a high-carbohydrate diet were significantly higher than those in the normal control group.

quote: Meanwhile, betaine supplementation significantly reduced the apoptosis rate in the HC + BET diet group compared with the HC group ( p 0.05).
statement: 与高碳水化合物组相比，甜菜碱补充剂显著降低了高碳水化合物加甜菜碱饮食组的凋亡率。
text_zh: 与高碳水化合物组相比，甜菜碱补充剂显著降低了高碳水化合物加甜菜碱饮食组的凋亡率。
text_en: Compared to the high-carbohydrate group, betaine supplementation significantly reduced the apoptosis rate in the high-carbohydrate plus betaine diet group.

quote: No significant differences in feed efficiency (FE), feeding rate (FR), and other morphological indices were observed between the groups
statement: 各组间在饲料效率、摄食率和其他形态指标上未观察到显著差异。
text_zh: 各组间在饲料效率、摄食率和其他形态指标上未观察到显著差异。
text_en: No significant differences were observed among groups in feed efficiency, feeding rate, and other morphological indicators.
intervention_record: 高碳水日粮中添加甜菜碱

quote: Compared with the NC group, the HC diet upregulated the transcript levels of ire1 , perk , atf6 , xbp1 , eif2a , atf4 , and chop .
statement: 与NC组相比，HC饮食上调了内质网应激相关基因（ire1, perk, atf6, xbp1, eif2a, atf4, chop）的转录水平。
text_zh: 与NC组相比，HC饮食上调了内质网应激相关基因（ire1, perk, atf6, xbp1, eif2a, atf4, chop）的转录水平。
text_en: Compared to the NC group, the HC diet upregulated the transcription levels of endoplasmic reticulum stress-related genes (ire1, perk, atf6, xbp1, eif2a, atf4, chop).

quote: Furthermore, the expression levels of perk and atf4 were significantly down-regulated in the HC + BET group compared with those in the HC group ( p 0.05).
statement: 此外，与HC组相比，HC+BET组的perk和atf4表达水平显著下调。
text_zh: 此外，与HC组相比，HC+BET组的perk和atf4表达水平显著下调。
text_en: In addition, compared with the HC group, the expression levels of perk and atf4 in the HC+BET group were significantly downregulated.
intervention_record: 高碳水日粮中添加甜菜碱

quote: Compared with the NC group, the HC diet induced significantly lower T-AOC levels but higher SOD and MDA levels in the livers of mandarin fish ( p 0.05).
statement: 与正常对照组相比，高胆固醇饮食导致鳜鱼肝脏总抗氧化能力显著降低，但超氧化物歧化酶和丙二醛水平升高。
text_zh: 与正常对照组相比，高胆固醇饮食导致鳜鱼肝脏总抗氧化能力显著降低，但超氧化物歧化酶和丙二醛水平升高。
text_en: Compared to the normal control group, a high-cholesterol diet significantly decreased the total antioxidant capacity in the liver of mandarin fish, but increased superoxide dismutase and malondialdehyde levels.

quote: In addition, the mRNA levels of keap1 and cat were significantly decreased in the HC + BET group compared with those in the HC group ( p 0.05).
statement: 此外，与高胆固醇组相比，高胆固醇加甜菜碱组的keap1和cat mRNA水平显著降低。
text_zh: 此外，与高胆固醇组相比，高胆固醇加甜菜碱组的keap1和cat mRNA水平显著降低。
text_en: In addition, compared with the high-cholesterol group, keap1 and cat mRNA levels were significantly lower in the high-cholesterol plus betaine group.
intervention_record: 高胆固醇饮食中添加甜菜碱

quote: There were no significant differences in the mRNA levels of gr and sod between the groups ( p 0.05).
statement: 各组间gr和sod的mRNA水平无显著差异。
text_zh: 各组间gr和sod的mRNA水平无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in the mRNA levels of gr and sod among groups.

quote: dietary betaine supplementation in the HC diet stimulated the activities of SOD and CAT and reduced the MDA levels in the livers of mandarin fish, suggesting an ameliorative effect of betaine in HC-diet-induced oxidative stress.
statement: 在HC日粮中添加甜菜碱刺激了鳜鱼肝脏中SOD和CAT的活性并降低了MDA水平，表明甜菜碱对HC日粮诱导的氧化应激有改善作用。
text_zh: 在HC日粮中添加甜菜碱刺激了鳜鱼肝脏中SOD和CAT的活性并降低了MDA水平，表明甜菜碱对HC日粮诱导的氧化应激有改善作用。
text_en: Adding betaine to the HC diet stimulated SOD and CAT activities in the liver of mandarin fish and reduced MDA levels, indicating that betaine has an ameliorating effect on oxidative stress induced by the HC diet.

quote: Overall, the HC diet induced oxidative stress in the livers of mandarin fish, and the use of betaine in the diet attenuated oxidative stress by stimulating the antioxidant responses.
statement: 总体而言，HC日粮诱导了鳜鱼肝脏的氧化应激，而日粮中使用甜菜碱通过刺激抗氧化反应减轻了氧化应激。
text_zh: 总体而言，HC日粮诱导了鳜鱼肝脏的氧化应激，而日粮中使用甜菜碱通过刺激抗氧化反应减轻了氧化应激。
text_en: Overall, HC diets induced oxidative stress in the liver of mandarin fish, while dietary betaine use alleviated oxidative stress by stimulating antioxidant responses.

quote: In the present study, the HC diet had significantly higher mRNA levels of ire1 , perk , atf6 , xbp1 , eif2a , atf4 , and chop in the livers of mandarin fish than in the NC group, indicating that the HC diet induced ER stress through the modulation of the PERK-eIF2a-ATF4 and IRE1-XBP1 pathways.
statement: 在本研究中，与NC组相比，HC日粮组的鳜鱼肝脏中ire1、perk、atf6、xbp1、eif2a、atf4和chop的mRNA水平显著升高，表明HC日粮通过调节PERK-eIF2a-ATF4和IRE1-XBP1通路诱导内质网应激。
text_zh: 在本研究中，与NC组相比，HC日粮组的鳜鱼肝脏中ire1、perk、atf6、xbp1、eif2a、atf4和chop的mRNA水平显著升高，表明HC日粮通过调节PERK-eIF2a-ATF4和IRE1-XBP1通路诱导内质网应激。
text_en: In this study, compared with the NC group, the mRNA levels of ire1, perk, atf6, xbp1, eif2a, atf4 and chop in the liver of mandarin fish were significantly increased in the HC diet group, indicating that the HC diet induced endoplasmic reticulum stress by regulating the PERK-eIF2a-ATF4 and IRE1-XBP1 pathways.

quote: ne supplementation improves growth performance in many aquatic animals, such as gibel carp ( Carassius auratus gibelio ), tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus ), blunt snout bream, and Macrobrachium rosenbergii [ 21 , 23 , 37 , 38 ].
statement: 甜菜碱补充剂改善了多种水生动物的生长性能。
text_zh: 甜菜碱补充剂改善了多种水生动物的生长性能。
text_en: Betaine supplementation improved the growth performance of various aquatic animals.

population.species: 鲫鱼、罗非鱼、团头鲂、罗氏沼虾

quote: 4.2. Betaine Mitigated HC-Diet-Induced Oxidative Stress in Mandarin Fish
statement: 甜菜碱缓解了高碳水化合物日粮诱导的鳜鱼氧化应激。
text_zh: 甜菜碱缓解了高碳水化合物日粮诱导的鳜鱼氧化应激。
text_en: Betaine alleviated oxidative stress induced by high-carbohydrate diets in mandarin fish.

quote: In the present study, the mRNA levels of nrf2/keap1 and its downstream genes of cat and gpx were significantly increased in mandarin fish fed the HC diet
statement: 在本研究中，饲喂高碳水化合物（HC）饲料的鳜鱼中nrf2/keap1及其下游基因cat和gpx的mRNA水平显著增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，饲喂高碳水化合物（HC）饲料的鳜鱼中nrf2/keap1及其下游基因cat和gpx的mRNA水平显著增加。
text_en: In this study, the mRNA levels of nrf2/keap1 and its downstream genes cat and gpx were significantly increased in mandarin fish fed a high-carbohydrate (HC) diet.

quote: The HC diet significantly reduced T-AOC levels but increased MDA contents in the livers of mandarin fish compared with the NC diet.
statement: 与正常碳水化合物（NC）饲料相比，高碳水化合物（HC）饲料显著降低了鳜鱼肝脏中的总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）水平，但增加了丙二醛（MDA）含量。
text_zh: 与正常碳水化合物（NC）饲料相比，高碳水化合物（HC）饲料显著降低了鳜鱼肝脏中的总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）水平，但增加了丙二醛（MDA）含量。
text_en: Compared to normal carbohydrate (NC) diet, high carbohydrate (HC) diet significantly decreased the total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC) level in the liver of mandarin fish, but increased malondialdehyde (MDA) content.

quote: MDA is considered a vital biomarker of lipid peroxidation under oxidative stress, which confirmed the occurrence of oxidative stress in mandarin fish fed the HC diet.
statement: MDA被认为是氧化应激下脂质过氧化的重要生物标志物，这证实了饲喂高碳水化合物饲料的鳜鱼发生了氧化应激。
text_zh: MDA被认为是氧化应激下脂质过氧化的重要生物标志物，这证实了饲喂高碳水化合物饲料的鳜鱼发生了氧化应激。
text_en: MDA is considered an important biomarker of lipid peroxidation under oxidative stress, which confirms that mandarin fish fed a high-carbohydrate diet experienced oxidative stress.

quote: Taken together, the HC diet stimulated the antioxidant system to counteract the disruption of redox homeostasis to some extent but failed to maintain the balance and ultimately caused oxidative stress in mandarin fish.
statement: 综上所述，高碳水化合物饲料在一定程度上刺激了抗氧化系统以对抗氧化还原稳态的破坏，但未能维持平衡，最终导致鳜鱼发生氧化应激。
text_zh: 综上所述，高碳水化合物饲料在一定程度上刺激了抗氧化系统以对抗氧化还原稳态的破坏，但未能维持平衡，最终导致鳜鱼发生氧化应激。
text_en: In summary, the high-carbohydrate diet stimulated the antioxidant system to a certain extent to counteract the disruption of redox homeostasis, but failed to maintain balance, ultimately leading to oxidative stress in mandarin fish.

quote: Similarly, dietary betaine supplementation in the HC diet stimulated the activities of SOD and CAT and reduced the MDA levels in the livers of mandarin fish, suggesting an ameliorative effect of betaine in HC-diet-induced oxidative s
statement: 同样，在高碳水化合物饲料中添加甜菜碱刺激了鳜鱼肝脏中SOD和CAT的活性并降低了MDA水平，表明甜菜碱对高碳水化合物饲料诱导的氧化应激具有改善作用。
text_zh: 同样，在高碳水化合物饲料中添加甜菜碱刺激了鳜鱼肝脏中SOD和CAT的活性并降低了MDA水平，表明甜菜碱对高碳水化合物饲料诱导的氧化应激具有改善作用。
text_en: Similarly, adding betaine to high-carbohydrate diets stimulated the activity of SOD and CAT in the liver of mandarin fish and reduced MDA levels, indicating that betaine has an ameliorative effect on oxidative stress induced by high-carbohydrate diets.
outcome: 抗氧化酶活性及氧化损伤

quote: Compared with the NC group, the mRNA levels of bcl2 and bax were significantly increased in the HC group ( p 0.05).
statement: 与正常对照组相比，高胆固醇饮食组鳜鱼肝脏中凋亡相关基因bcl2和bax的mRNA水平显著升高。
text_zh: 与正常对照组相比，高胆固醇饮食组鳜鱼肝脏中凋亡相关基因bcl2和bax的mRNA水平显著升高。
text_en: Compared with the normal control group, the mRNA levels of apoptosis-related genes bcl2 and bax in the liver of mandarin fish were significantly increased in the high-cholesterol diet group.

quote: However, excessive dietary carbohydrates always have a negative effect on the growth of many fish species, including eel and largemouth bass
statement: 过量的膳食碳水化合物通常对许多鱼类的生长产生负面影响，包括鳗鱼和大口黑鲈。
text_zh: 过量的膳食碳水化合物通常对许多鱼类的生长产生负面影响，包括鳗鱼和大口黑鲈。
text_en: Excess dietary carbohydrates usually have a negative effect on the growth of many fish species, including eels and largemouth bass.

quote: On the contrary, some studies have also demonstrated that high carbohydrate diets have no effect on growth, such as in the Indian major carp ( Cirrhinus mrigala ) and rainbow trout ( Oncorhynchus mykiss )
statement: 相反，一些研究也表明高碳水化合物饮食对生长没有影响，例如在印度主要鲤鱼（Cirrhinus mrigala）和虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）中。
text_zh: 相反，一些研究也表明高碳水化合物饮食对生长没有影响，例如在印度主要鲤鱼（Cirrhinus mrigala）和虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）中。
text_en: Conversely, some studies also indicate that high-carbohydrate diets have no effect on growth, for example in Indian major carp (Cirrhinus mrigala) and rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss).

population.species: 印度主要鲤鱼; 虹鳟

quote: This result was in line with a previous study that mandarin fish achieved maximum SGRs when fed a high carbohydrate diet
statement: 这一结果与之前的研究一致，即鳜鱼在喂食高碳水化合物饮食时达到了最大特定生长率。
text_zh: 这一结果与之前的研究一致，即鳜鱼在喂食高碳水化合物饮食时达到了最大特定生长率。
text_en: This result is consistent with previous studies, which found that mandarin fish reached their maximum specific growth rate when fed a high-carbohydrate diet.

statement: 各组间的饲料效率无显著差异。
text_zh: 各组间的饲料效率无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in feed efficiency between groups.

statement: 各组间的摄食率无显著差异。
text_zh: 各组间的摄食率无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in feeding rates between groups.

statement: 各组间的脏体指数无显著差异。
text_zh: 各组间的脏体指数无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in the viscera index among groups.

quote: Previous researches have indicated that numerous environmental factors, such as temperature, dissolved oxygen, and salinity, can influence the metabolism and immune response of mandarin fish
statement: 先前的研究表明，温度、溶解氧和盐度等环境因素会影响鳜鱼的代谢和免疫反应。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，温度、溶解氧和盐度等环境因素会影响鳜鱼的代谢和免疫反应。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that environmental factors such as temperature, dissolved oxygen, and salinity affect the metabolism and immune response of mandarin fish.

quote: Recently, the mandarin fish aquaculture industry has incurred significant losses due to viral diseases, notably infectious sple
statement: 最近，由于病毒性疾病（特别是传染性脾肾坏死病），鳜鱼养殖业遭受了重大损失。
text_zh: 最近，由于病毒性疾病（特别是传染性脾肾坏死病），鳜鱼养殖业遭受了重大损失。
text_en: Recently, the mandarin fish aquaculture industry has suffered significant losses due to viral diseases (particularly infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus disease).

quote: Taken together, dietary betaine supplementation reduced the HC-diet-induced apoptosis via attenuating the ER stress and autophagy in mandarin fish.
statement: 综上所述，膳食甜菜碱补充剂通过减轻鳜鱼的内质网应激和自噬来减少高碳水日粮诱导的细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 综上所述，膳食甜菜碱补充剂通过减轻鳜鱼的内质网应激和自噬来减少高碳水日粮诱导的细胞凋亡。
text_en: In summary, dietary betaine supplementation reduces high-carbohydrate diet-induced apoptosis in Chinese perch by alleviating endoplasmic reticulum stress and autophagy.

quote: The HC diet induced oxidative stress, ER stress, and its associated autophagy, ultimately leading to apoptosis in the livers of mandarin fish.
statement: 高碳水化合物饮食诱导了氧化应激、内质网应激及其相关的自噬，最终导致鳜鱼肝脏细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 高碳水化合物饮食诱导了氧化应激、内质网应激及其相关的自噬，最终导致鳜鱼肝脏细胞凋亡。
text_en: A high-carbohydrate diet induced oxidative stress, endoplasmic reticulum stress and its associated autophagy, ultimately leading to apoptosis of liver cells in mandarin fish.

quote: In addition, dietary betaine attenuated HC-diet-induced oxidative stress by activating antioxidant enzymes such as CAT and SOD in the livers of mandarin fish.
statement: 此外，膳食甜菜碱通过激活鳜鱼肝脏中的CAT和SOD等抗氧化酶，减轻了高碳水化合物饮食诱导的氧化应激。
text_zh: 此外，膳食甜菜碱通过激活鳜鱼肝脏中的CAT和SOD等抗氧化酶，减轻了高碳水化合物饮食诱导的氧化应激。
text_en: In addition, dietary betaine alleviated oxidative stress induced by a high-carbohydrate diet in the liver of mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi) by activating antioxidant enzymes such as CAT and SOD.

quote: The use of betaine in the HC diet significantly alleviated ER stress by regulating the PERK-eIF2a-ATF4 pathway, mitigated the autophagic process via becn1 , and attenuated apoptosis in the livers of mandarin fish ( Figure 7 ).
statement: 在高碳水化合物饮食中使用甜菜碱通过调节PERK-eIF2a-ATF4通路显著缓解了内质网应激，通过becn1减轻了自噬过程，并减弱了鳜鱼肝脏中的细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 在高碳水化合物饮食中使用甜菜碱通过调节PERK-eIF2a-ATF4通路显著缓解了内质网应激，通过becn1减轻了自噬过程，并减弱了鳜鱼肝脏中的细胞凋亡。
text_en: In a high-carbohydrate diet, the use of betaine significantly alleviated endoplasmic reticulum stress by regulating the PERK-eIF2a-ATF4 pathway, reduced autophagy through becn1, and attenuated apoptosis in the liver of Siniperca chuatsi.
intervention_record: 高碳水日粮中添加甜菜碱
outcome: 内质网应激、自噬及细胞凋亡

quote: In addition, the pro-apoptotic indicator bax was significantly higher in the HC group of mandarin fish, which was in line with the results in largemouth bass [ 14 ] that the HC diet induced apoptosis in the liver.
statement: 此外，鳜鱼HC组的促凋亡指标bax显著升高，这与大口黑鲷的研究结果一致，即HC日粮诱导了肝脏细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 此外，鳜鱼HC组的促凋亡指标bax显著升高，这与大口黑鲷的研究结果一致，即HC日粮诱导了肝脏细胞凋亡。
text_en: In addition, the pro-apoptotic indicator bax was significantly increased in the HC group of mandarin fish, which is consistent with the research results on largemouth bass, namely that the HC diet induced hepatocyte apoptosis.

quote: The significantly upregulated mRNA levels of apoptosis genes in the HC group were further confirmed by the significantly obvious apoptosis signals and apoptosis rate in the livers of mandarin fish using the TUNEL assay.
statement: 使用TUNEL测定法检测到的鳜鱼肝脏中显著的凋亡信号和凋亡率，进一步证实了HC组中凋亡基因mRNA水平的显著上调。
text_zh: 使用TUNEL测定法检测到的鳜鱼肝脏中显著的凋亡信号和凋亡率，进一步证实了HC组中凋亡基因mRNA水平的显著上调。
text_en: Significant apoptotic signals and apoptosis rates in the liver of mandarin fish detected by the TUNEL assay further confirmed the significant upregulation of apoptosis gene mRNA levels in the HC group.

quote: As a whole, the HC diet induced ER stress and subsequently stimulated autophagic progression, leading to apoptosis in mandarin fish, as compared with the NC diet.
statement: 总体而言，与NC日粮相比，HC日粮在鳜鱼中诱导了内质网应激并随后刺激自噬进程，导致细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 总体而言，与NC日粮相比，HC日粮在鳜鱼中诱导了内质网应激并随后刺激自噬进程，导致细胞凋亡。
text_en: Overall, compared to the NC diet, the HC diet induced endoplasmic reticulum stress and subsequently stimulated autophagy in mandarin fish, leading to apoptosis.
outcome: 内质网应激及细胞凋亡

quote: The use of dietary antioxidants has been widely used in aquafeed to prevent aquatic animals from suffering from environmental stress or nutritional imbalance [ 15 , 17 , 18 ].
statement: 膳食抗氧化剂已广泛用于水产饲料中，以防止水生动物遭受环境胁迫或营养失衡。
text_zh: 膳食抗氧化剂已广泛用于水产饲料中，以防止水生动物遭受环境胁迫或营养失衡。
text_en: Dietary antioxidants have been widely used in aquaculture feed to prevent aquatic animals from suffering environmental stress or nutritional imbalance.
outcome: 环境胁迫或营养失衡防护

quote: Regarding the effects of dietary betaine use in diets, significantly lower mRNA levels of eif2a and chop in the BET group and perk and atf4 in the HC + BET group were observed in the livers of mandarin fish, compared with the NC and HC groups, respectively.
statement: 与NC和HC组相比，BET组鳜鱼肝脏中eif2a和chop的mRNA水平显著降低，HC+BET组中perk和atf4的mRNA水平也显著降低。
text_zh: 与NC和HC组相比，BET组鳜鱼肝脏中eif2a和chop的mRNA水平显著降低，HC+BET组中perk和atf4的mRNA水平也显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the NC and HC groups, the mRNA levels of eif2a and chop in the liver of mandarin fish were significantly decreased in the BET group; the mRNA levels of perk and atf4 were also significantly decreased in the HC+BET group.
outcome: 内质网应激相关基因表达

quote: Prior to handling, the fish were sedated using a solution of MS-222 (Sigma-Aldrich, USA) at a concentration of 40 to 50 mg/L in water.
statement: 在处理前，使用浓度为40至50 mg/L的MS-222水溶液对鱼进行镇静。
text_zh: 在处理前，使用浓度为40至50 mg/L的MS-222水溶液对鱼进行镇静。
text_en: Before processing, fish were sedated using an aqueous solution of MS-222 at a concentration of 40 to 50 mg/L.

quote: Therefore, betaine in the HC diet significantly alleviated ER stress by regulating the PERK-eIF2a-ATF4 pathway (a branch of the UPR pathway) in the livers of mandarin fish.
statement: 因此，高碳水饮食中的甜菜碱通过调节PERK-eIF2a-ATF4通路显著缓解了鳜鱼肝脏的内质网应激。
text_zh: 因此，高碳水饮食中的甜菜碱通过调节PERK-eIF2a-ATF4通路显著缓解了鳜鱼肝脏的内质网应激。
text_en: Therefore, betaine in a high-carbohydrate diet significantly alleviated endoplasmic reticulum stress in the liver of mandarin fish by regulating the PERK-eIF2a-ATF4 pathway.

quote: Since ER stress is a potent trigger for autophagy [ 11 ], the suppression of ER stress also induced the down-regulation of autophagy, as indicated by the significantly lower level of becn1 in the livers of mandarin fish fed the HC + BET diet.
statement: 由于内质网应激是自噬的有力触发因素，内质网应激的抑制也诱导了自噬的下调，表现为喂食HC+BET日粮的鳜鱼肝脏中becn1水平显著降低。
text_zh: 由于内质网应激是自噬的有力触发因素，内质网应激的抑制也诱导了自噬的下调，表现为喂食HC+BET日粮的鳜鱼肝脏中becn1水平显著降低。
text_en: Since endoplasmic reticulum stress is a powerful trigger of autophagy, the inhibition of endoplasmic reticulum stress also induced the downregulation of autophagy, as evidenced by significantly reduced becn1 levels in the livers of mandarin fish fed the HC+BET diet.

quote: In the present study, the transcriptional levels of bax were significantly lower in the HC + BET group than in the HC group.
statement: 在本研究中，HC+BET组的bax转录水平显著低于HC组。
text_zh: 在本研究中，HC+BET组的bax转录水平显著低于HC组。
text_en: In this study, the bax transcription level in the HC+BET group was significantly lower than that in the HC group.

quote: In addition, betaine supplementation significantly reduced the apoptosis rate in the livers of mandarin fish compared with the HC diet, as shown by histological observation, indicating an alleviating effect on apoptosis in the livers of mandarin fish fed the HC diet with betaine.
statement: 此外，组织学观察显示，与HC日粮相比，补充甜菜碱显著降低了鳜鱼肝脏的细胞凋亡率，表明甜菜碱对喂食HC日粮的鳜鱼肝脏凋亡具有缓解作用。
text_zh: 此外，组织学观察显示，与HC日粮相比，补充甜菜碱显著降低了鳜鱼肝脏的细胞凋亡率，表明甜菜碱对喂食HC日粮的鳜鱼肝脏凋亡具有缓解作用。
text_en: In addition, histological observations showed that compared with the HC diet, betaine supplementation significantly reduced the apoptosis rate in the liver of mandarin fish, indicating that betaine has a mitigating effect on liver apoptosis in mandarin fish fed the HC diet.

quote: examination of the tissue expression patterns of ten selected TRP genes following exposure to both high and low temperature stress indicated the expression of TRP genes were responsive to temperatures changes.
statement: 对暴露于高温和低温胁迫后的十个选定TRP基因的组织表达模式检查表明，TRP基因的表达对温度变化有反应。
text_zh: 对暴露于高温和低温胁迫后的十个选定TRP基因的组织表达模式检查表明，TRP基因的表达对温度变化有反应。
text_en: Examination of the tissue expression patterns of ten selected TRP genes after exposure to high and low temperature stress showed that the expression of TRP genes responds to temperature changes.

quote: In the current era of global warming and increasingly frequent climate extremes, teleost fish are consistently subjected to temperature fluctuations during their breeding and cultivation cycles.
statement: 在全球变暖和气候极端事件日益频繁的背景下，硬骨鱼在繁殖和养殖周期中持续遭受温度波动的影响。
text_zh: 在全球变暖和气候极端事件日益频繁的背景下，硬骨鱼在繁殖和养殖周期中持续遭受温度波动的影响。
text_en: In the context of global warming and increasingly frequent extreme climate events, bony fish are continuously subjected to temperature fluctuations during their breeding and farming cycles.

quote: The fish were randomly allocated to three treatment groups, each consisting of five biological replicates, and exposed to distinct temperature conditions (17 ± 0.5 °C, 27 ± 0.5 °C, 37 ± 0.5 °C) [ 22 ].
statement: 鳜鱼被随机分配到三个处理组，每组五个生物学重复，并暴露于不同的温度条件（17 ± 0.5 °C、27 ± 0.5 °C、37 ± 0.5 °C）。
text_zh: 鳜鱼被随机分配到三个处理组，每组五个生物学重复，并暴露于不同的温度条件（17 ± 0.5 °C、27 ± 0.5 °C、37 ± 0.5 °C）。
text_en: Mandarin fish were randomly assigned to three treatment groups, with five biological replicates per group, and exposed to different temperature conditions (17 ± 0.5 °C, 27 ± 0.5 °C, 37 ± 0.5 °C).

quote: the mandarin fish aquaculture industry has incurred significant losses due to viral diseases, notably infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus (ISKNV), mandarin fish iridovirus (MRV), and Siniperca chuatsi rhabdovirus (SCRV), under high-density farming practices coupled with intense fluctuations in environmental temperature
statement: 在高密度养殖实践和环境温度剧烈波动的条件下，鳜鱼养殖业因传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）、鳜鱼虹彩病毒（MRV）和鳜鱼弹状病毒（SCRV）等病毒性疾病遭受重大损失。
text_zh: 在高密度养殖实践和环境温度剧烈波动的条件下，鳜鱼养殖业因传染性脾肾坏死病毒（ISKNV）、鳜鱼虹彩病毒（MRV）和鳜鱼弹状病毒（SCRV）等病毒性疾病遭受重大损失。
text_en: Under conditions of high-density farming practices and drastic fluctuations in environmental temperature, the mandarin fish aquaculture industry suffers significant losses due to viral diseases such as Infectious Spleen and Kidney Necrosis Virus (ISKNV), Mandarin Fish Iridovirus (MRV), and Siniperca Chuatsi Rhabdovirus (SCRV).
intervention_record: 高密度养殖与环境温度波动

quote: Prior to their use in the study, they were acclimatized for a two-week period at a temperature of 27 °C
statement: 在用于研究之前，鱼在27°C的温度下驯化两周。
text_zh: 在用于研究之前，鱼在27°C的温度下驯化两周。
text_en: Before being used for research, the fish were acclimated at a temperature of 27°C for two weeks.

quote: Benfotiamine ameliorates high-carbohydrate diet-induced hepatic oxidative stress, inflammation and apoptosis in Megalobrama amblycephala.
statement: 苯磷硫胺可改善高碳水化合物饮食诱导的鳊鱼肝脏氧化应激、炎症和细胞凋亡。

quote: We found that MRV infection elicits broad relative expression changes within the TRP family genes, whereas the changes induced by ISKNV infection within the TRP family are notably less pronounced, despite both MRV and ISKNV belonging to the family Iridoviridae and causing a fatality rate higher than 90% in the mandarin fish [ 50 , 51 ].
statement: 研究发现MRV感染引起TRP家族基因广泛的相对表达变化，而ISKNV感染引起的TRP家族内变化明显较小，尽管两者均属于虹彩病毒科且在鳜鱼中致死率超过90%。
text_zh: 研究发现MRV感染引起TRP家族基因广泛的相对表达变化，而ISKNV感染引起的TRP家族内变化明显较小，尽管两者均属于虹彩病毒科且在鳜鱼中致死率超过90%。
text_en: The study found that MRV infection caused widespread relative expression changes in TRP family genes, while the changes within the TRP family induced by ISKNV infection were significantly smaller, although both belong to the Iridoviridae family and have a mortality rate exceeding 90% in mandarin fish.

text_en: This study investigated the effects of dietary arginine supplementation on growth performance, antioxidant capacity, intestinal digestive enzyme activity, muscle transcriptome, and gut health in mandarin fish.
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化能力、肠道健康

quote: Four isonitrogenous and isolipidic diets (50% crude protein, 11% crude lipid) with graded levels (2.61%, 2.99%, 3.37%, and 3.82%) of arginine were formulated and processed.
statement: 配制并加工了四种等氮等脂（粗蛋白50%，粗脂肪11%）且精氨酸水平梯度递增（2.61%、2.99%、3.37%和3.82%）的日粮。
text_zh: 配制并加工了四种等氮等脂（粗蛋白50%，粗脂肪11%）且精氨酸水平梯度递增（2.61%、2.99%、3.37%和3.82%）的日粮。
text_en: Four iso-nitrogenous and iso-lipidic diets (50% crude protein, 11% crude fat) with increasing arginine levels (2.61%, 2.99%, 3.37%, and 3.82%) were formulated and processed.

quote: A total of 360 Chinese perch (approximately 45–46 g) were randomly divided into four groups with triplicates of 30 ﬁsh per cage in each group.
statement: 将360尾鳜鱼（约45-46克）随机分为四组，每组设三个重复，每笼30尾鱼。
text_zh: 将360尾鳜鱼（约45-46克）随机分为四组，每组设三个重复，每笼30尾鱼。
text_en: 360 mandarin fish (about 45-46 g) were randomly divided into four groups, with three replicates per group and 30 fish per cage.

quote: Our results revealed that although there was no signiﬁcant improvement in the growth performance of Chinese perch, their antioxidant capacity and nutritional metabolism were signiﬁcantly improved.
statement: 研究结果显示，虽然鳜鱼的生长性能没有显著改善，但其抗氧化能力和营养代谢显著改善。
text_zh: 研究结果显示，虽然鳜鱼的生长性能没有显著改善，但其抗氧化能力和营养代谢显著改善。
text_en: The study results showed that although there was no significant improvement in the growth performance of mandarin fish, their antioxidant capacity and nutritional metabolism were significantly improved.
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化能力、营养代谢

quote: все они были травмированы шипами своих сородичей при сортировках, пересадках и взвешиваниях.
statement: Крупные рыбы получали травмы от шипов сородичей во время процедур сортировки, пересадки и взвешивания.
text_en: Крупные рыбы получали травмы от шипов сородичей во время процедур сортировки, пересадки и взвешивания.

quote: Личинки и молодь питаются только живыми личинками и молодью карповых рыб... Они не потребляют зоопланктон и искусственные стартовые корма.
statement: Личинки и молодь китайского окуня питаются исключительно живой пищей (личинками и молодью карповых рыб) и отказываются от зоопланктона и искусственных кормов.
text_en: Личинки и молодь китайского окуня питаются исключительно живой пищей (личинками и молодью карповых рыб) и отказываются от зоопланктона и искусственных кормов.

quote: Сеголетки от позднего нереста молодых производителей вырастают в прудах до 40−60 г, после этого в садках увеличивают свою массу незначительно, что связано с низкой температурой воды.
statement: Сеголетки от позднего нереста слабо растут в садках из-за низкой температуры воды.
text_en: Сеголетки от позднего нереста слабо растут в садках из-за низкой температуры воды.

quote: Compared to the control group (without arginine supplementation, 2.61% group), feeding graded arginine levels could signiﬁcantly (P < 0.05) decrease serum glucose and malondialdehyde (MDA) contents, as well as increase total superoxide dismutase (TSOD) activity.
statement: 与对照组相比，饲喂不同水平的精氨酸可显著降低血清葡萄糖和丙二醛（MDA）含量，并提高总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）活性。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，饲喂不同水平的精氨酸可显著降低血清葡萄糖和丙二醛（MDA）含量，并提高总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）活性。
text_en: Compared with the control group, feeding different levels of arginine significantly reduced serum glucose and malondialdehyde (MDA) content, and increased total superoxide dismutase (TSOD) activity.
outcome: 血糖水平、氧化应激指标（MDA）、抗氧化酶活性（TSOD）

quote: Fish fed a 3.37% arginine diet had the highest TSOD activity in the serum and liver.
statement: 饲喂3.37%精氨酸日粮的鱼在血清和肝脏中具有最高的TSOD活性。
text_zh: 饲喂3.37%精氨酸日粮的鱼在血清和肝脏中具有最高的TSOD活性。
text_en: Fish fed a 3.37% arginine diet had the highest TSOD activity in serum and liver.

quote: The intestinal morphological structure was clearer and more uniform in the 2.99% and 3.37% arginine groups.
statement: 在2.99%和3.37%精氨酸组中，肠道形态结构更清晰且更均匀。
text_zh: 在2.99%和3.37%精氨酸组中，肠道形态结构更清晰且更均匀。
text_en: In the 2.99% and 3.37% arginine groups, the intestinal morphological structure was clearer and more uniform.

quote: Fish fed with 3.82% arginine had signiﬁcantly decreased (P < 0.05) muscle valine, glutamate, tyrosine, and total non-essential amino acid contents, with decreased (P < 0.05) intestinal amylase activity.
statement: 饲喂3.82%精氨酸的鱼肌肉中的缬氨酸、谷氨酸、酪氨酸和总非必需氨基酸含量显著降低，且肠道淀粉酶活性降低。
text_zh: 饲喂3.82%精氨酸的鱼肌肉中的缬氨酸、谷氨酸、酪氨酸和总非必需氨基酸含量显著降低，且肠道淀粉酶活性降低。
text_en: Feeding a diet with 3.82% arginine significantly decreased the valine, glutamic acid, tyrosine, and total non-essential amino acid contents in fish muscle, and decreased intestinal amylase activity.
outcome: 肌肉氨基酸组成、消化酶活性
counterevidence: 高剂量精氨酸导致肌肉特定氨基酸减少及肠道淀粉酶活性降低

quote: The microbial community structure did not change signiﬁcantly.
statement: 微生物群落结构没有发生显著变化。
text_zh: 微生物群落结构没有发生显著变化。
text_en: The microbial community structure did not change significantly.

quote:
The
ability of arginine to impact nutrient metabolism, inﬂuence insulin
release, modulate immune and antioxidant response, and improve
disease resistance in ﬁsh has been well demonstrated (Wang Q. et al.,
2021).
statement: 精氨酸影响营养代谢、调节胰岛素释放、调节免疫和抗氧化反应以及提高鱼类抗病能力的作用已得到充分证实。
text_zh: 精氨酸影响营养代谢、调节胰岛素释放、调节免疫和抗氧化反应以及提高鱼类抗病能力的作用已得到充分证实。
text_en: The effects of arginine on nutritional metabolism, regulation of insulin release, regulation of immune and antioxidant responses, and improvement of disease resistance in fish have been well established.

quote:
Like other
animals, lack of arginine may interfere with the ﬁsh body normal
function of riboﬂavin, which is not conducive to the synthesis of heme
and niacin, as well as decrease resistance against pathogen challenges
(Huo et al., 2023).
statement: 与其他动物一样，缺乏精氨酸可能会干扰鱼体内核黄素的正常功能，不利于血红素和烟酸的合成，并降低对病原体攻击的抵抗力。
text_zh: 与其他动物一样，缺乏精氨酸可能会干扰鱼体内核黄素的正常功能，不利于血红素和烟酸的合成，并降低对病原体攻击的抵抗力。
text_en: As with other animals, arginine deficiency may interfere with the normal function of riboflavin in fish, be detrimental to the synthesis of heme and niacin, and reduce resistance to pathogen attacks.

quote: The feeding period lasted for 56 days, with the ﬁsh fed to apparent satiation twice a day (6:00 and 18:00).
statement: 实验期间鱼类每日两次（6:00和18:00）投喂至表观饱食，持续56天。
text_zh: 实验期间鱼类每日两次（6:00和18:00）投喂至表观饱食，持续56天。
text_en: During the experimental period, fish were fed to apparent satiation twice daily (at 6:00 and 18:00) for 56 days.

quote: Water quality was tested regularly: the temperature ranged 26–32°C, ammonia nitrogen was less than 0.5 mg/L, and the pH ranged 7.5–8.5.
statement: 定期检测水质，温度范围为26–32°C，氨氮低于0.5 mg/L，pH值范围为7.5–8.5。
text_zh: 定期检测水质，温度范围为26–32°C，氨氮低于0.5 mg/L，pH值范围为7.5–8.5。
text_en: Regularly test water quality, with a temperature range of 26–32°C, ammonia nitrogen below 0.5 mg/L, and a pH range of 7.5–8.5.

quote: The water was continuously aerated to keep dissolved oxygen at 7.0–9.3 mg/L.
statement: 通过连续曝气将溶解氧维持在7.0–9.3 mg/L。
text_zh: 通过连续曝气将溶解氧维持在7.0–9.3 mg/L。
text_en: Dissolved oxygen was maintained at 7.0–9.3 mg/L through continuous aeration.

quote: After the feeding period, the ﬁsh were starved for 24 h and then anesthetized with MS222 for weighing and counting.
statement: 饲养期结束后，鱼先禁食24小时，随后使用MS222麻醉进行称重和计数。
text_zh: 饲养期结束后，鱼先禁食24小时，随后使用MS222麻醉进行称重和计数。
text_en: After the rearing period, the fish were fasted for 24 hours, then anesthetized with MS222 for weighing and counting.

quote: Total superoxide dismutase (TSOD) and malondialdehyde (MDA) in serum, liver, and intestines, as well as digestive enzyme activities (trypsin, lipase, and amylase), were measured using
statement: 血清、肝脏和肠道中的总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）和丙二醛（MDA），以及消化酶活性（胰蛋白酶、脂肪酶和淀粉酶）均通过...进行测量。
text_zh: 血清、肝脏和肠道中的总超氧化物歧化酶（TSOD）和丙二醛（MDA），以及消化酶活性（胰蛋白酶、脂肪酶和淀粉酶）均通过...进行测量。
text_en: Total superoxide dismutase (TSOD) and malondialdehyde (MDA) in serum, liver, and intestine, as well as digestive enzyme activities (trypsin, lipase, and amylase), were measured by...
intervention_record: 抗氧化及消化酶指标检测
outcome: 氧化应激与消化功能评估

quote: There was no signiﬁcant variation in FCR, FI, and SR among all groups (P > 0.05); the highest SR (96.67%) occurred with 3.37% dietary arginine levels.
statement: 各组间的饲料系数、采食量和存活率无显著变化（P > 0.05）；最高存活率（96.67%）出现在日粮精氨酸水平为3.37%时。
text_zh: 各组间的饲料系数、采食量和存活率无显著变化（P > 0.05）；最高存活率（96.67%）出现在日粮精氨酸水平为3.37%时。
text_en: There was no significant difference in feed conversion ratio, feed intake and survival rate among the groups (P > 0.05); the highest survival rate (96.67%) occurred at a dietary arginine level of 3.37%.

quote: Dietary arginine levels had no signiﬁcant effect on intestinal trypsin and lipase activities (P > 0.05) (Table 4).
statement: 日粮精氨酸水平对肠道胰蛋白酶和脂肪酶活性无显著影响（P > 0.05）。
text_zh: 日粮精氨酸水平对肠道胰蛋白酶和脂肪酶活性无显著影响（P > 0.05）。
text_en: Dietary arginine levels had no significant effect on intestinal trypsin and lipase activity (P > 0.05).

quote: To close this gap, this study evaluated the inﬂuence of dietary arginine on Chinese perch based on growth performance, antioxidant capacity, intestinal digestive enzyme activity, and gut health.
statement: 本研究评估了日粮精氨酸对鳜鱼生长性能、抗氧化能力、肠道消化酶活性和肠道健康的影响。
text_zh: 本研究评估了日粮精氨酸对鳜鱼生长性能、抗氧化能力、肠道消化酶活性和肠道健康的影响。
text_en: This study evaluated the effects of dietary arginine on growth performance, antioxidant capacity, intestinal digestive enzyme activity, and gut health in mandarin fish.
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化能力、肠道消化酶活性、肠道健康

quote: At the beginning of the experiment, the acclimated Chinese perch were starved for 24 h, and the healthy-looking ones with an initial weight of 45–46 g were distributed into 12 cages at 30 ﬁsh per cage.
statement: 实验开始时，驯化后的鳜鱼禁食24小时，选取外观健康、初始体重为45-46克的个体，以每箱30尾的密度分入12个网箱中。
text_zh: 实验开始时，驯化后的鳜鱼禁食24小时，选取外观健康、初始体重为45-46克的个体，以每箱30尾的密度分入12个网箱中。
text_en: At the start of the experiment, acclimated mandarin fish were fasted for 24 hours. Individuals that appeared healthy and had an initial body weight of 45-46 g were selected and assigned to 12 net cages at a density of 30 fish per cage.
outcome: 初始健康状况与放养密度

quote: Двухлетки при кормлении мелкой живой малоценной рыбой вырастают до 425 г при вариабельности массы от 180 до 970 г, 82 % из них представлены особями массой от 300 до 600 г.
statement: Двухлетки китайского окуня при кормлении мелкой живой рыбой достигают средней массы 425 г с высокой вариабельностью веса.
text_en: Двухлетки китайского окуня при кормлении мелкой живой рыбой достигают средней массы 425 г с высокой вариабельностью веса.

quote: Попытка приучения двухлеток к искусственным влажным кормам посредством постепенного перехода с живой рыбы на неживую, резаную, в виде фарша, а затем гранул успеха не имела.
statement: Попытка перевести двухлеток с живой рыбы на искусственные влажные кормы через этапы (неживая, резаная, фарш, гранулы) оказалась неудачной.
text_en: Попытка перевести двухлеток с живой рыбы на искусственные влажные кормы через этапы (неживая, резаная, фарш, гранулы) оказалась неудачной.

quote: В этот же период отмечена лучшая усвояемость корма.
statement: В период высокой активности питания (выше 26°C) отмечается лучшая усвояемость корма.
text_en: В период высокой активности питания (выше 26°C) отмечается лучшая усвояемость корма.

quote: Results of principal coordinates analysis (PCoA) indicated that arginine supplementation would not signiﬁcantly disturb the gut bacterial community (P > 0.05)
statement: 精氨酸补充不会显著扰乱肠道菌群。
text_zh: 精氨酸补充不会显著扰乱肠道菌群。
text_en: Arginine supplementation does not significantly disrupt the gut microbiota.

quote: As shown in Figure 1, there were no signiﬁcant pathological changes in the structure of the midgut tissue of each group, with clear mucosal folds, mucosal layer, submucosal layer, muscular layer, and serosal layer.
statement: 各组中肠组织结构未见显著病理变化，黏膜皱襞及各层结构清晰。
text_zh: 各组中肠组织结构未见显著病理变化，黏膜皱襞及各层结构清晰。
text_en: No significant pathological changes were observed in the intestinal tissue structure of each group, and the mucosal folds and all layers were clearly defined.

quote: Compared with the control group, the density of intestinal villi increased, and the morphological structure was clearer and more uniform in the 2.99% and 3.37% arginine groups.
statement: 与对照组相比，2.99%和3.37%精氨酸组的肠绒毛密度增加，形态结构更清晰均匀。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，2.99%和3.37%精氨酸组的肠绒毛密度增加，形态结构更清晰均匀。
text_en: Compared with the control group, intestinal villus density increased and morphological structure was clearer and more uniform in the 2.99% and 3.37% arginine groups.

quote: Effect of dietary arginine levels on antioxidant enzyme activities and serum glucose of Chinese perch (Siniperca chuatsi).
statement: 日粮精氨酸水平影响鳜鱼的抗氧化酶活性和血清葡萄糖。
text_zh: 日粮精氨酸水平影响鳜鱼的抗氧化酶活性和血清葡萄糖。
text_en: Dietary arginine levels affect the antioxidant enzyme activity and serum glucose of Chinese perch.
